evidence: RED timed out while daemon ED2K runtime ignored native server bootstrap rows. GREEN queries a local TCP server from the native bootstrap row and publishes discovered source count through task.ed2k.source.updated.

acceptance: Daemon ED2K tasks load native Kad bootstrap rows and run bounded Kad source discovery into the task source pool.
evidence: RED timed out while daemon ED2K runtime ignored native Kad bootstrap rows. GREEN queries a local UDP Kad contact from the native bootstrap row and publishes discovered source count through task.ed2k.source.updated.

acceptance: Created /api/v1/ed2k/searches resources transition from queued to completed or failed with server and Kad result evidence.
evidence: RED failed because no daemon search worker existed. GREEN runs queued native ED2K search resources through a local Kad keyword lookup, records native result rows, and transitions the search lifecycle to completed.

acceptance: Discovery loops honor cancellation, bounded timeouts, source caps, and native task rate policy without busy loops.
validation: cargo test -p raria-cli ed2k_runtime_cancelled_before_discovery_exits_without_network_probe --locked -- --nocapture; cargo test -p raria-cli ed2k_inline_peer_transfer_honors_cancellable_download_limit --locked -- --nocapture
evidence: RED timed out while a cancelled daemon task could still enter discovery. RED also completed an inline peer transfer without applying the native task download limiter before disk writes. GREEN exits before discovery when cancelled, cancels in-flight server and Kad discovery with tokio::select, caps discovered source counts by ed2k.max_sources_per_task, and gates inline peer bytes through the native cancellable limiter before applying verified disk parts.
